title: 第1章 方羽第2章 大专生和本科生
content_zh:
;;
旧历2046年，即新历60年。
7月12日。
蓝星，夏国，湖广行省，武陵市。
下午两点，盛夏的太阳如同大火球，万里无云，除过往车辆，大部分街道上根本没多少行人。
但临街一栋占地极广、外表装潢充满科技感的五层建筑门口，此刻停满汽车，大量家长正带着穿戴练功服的少年少女顶着太阳涌入其中。
建筑牌匾上，正写着‘铁山武社’四个大字，底部还有着一行小字‘新街口分社’。
门口一侧还贴着十多张崭新海报：
“《新历60年夏季招生大优惠》：针对黄金段年龄学子，学费5888820课时，巡天武者坐镇、精英武者一对一指点，冲刺武道本科的最强助力！！”
“《‘父母证’冲刺班》：针对30岁前的白银年龄段成年人，冲刺成功，有生育资格，一胎奖励百万！！”
“《从末流高中到最强大学的逆袭》：本社培养的精英学员，新历59年市高考状元、新月武道大学杰出学子‘蒋辰逸’专题讲座……”
……
四楼，一间占地超500平米的武道室内。
地面上铺着厚厚的特制垫，四周摆放着沙袋、木人桩、兵器架等器物，另一侧还有拳力检测仪、身法检测仪、生命检测仪等仪器。
四十多名外表约莫十三四岁的初中生，正穿着统一的练功服，站桩练功。
“双脚开立与肩同宽，脚尖微内扣。膝盖微屈，不超过脚尖。含胸拔背，头顶虚悬……”穿着教练服的的方羽，耐心指点每位学员。
他身高大概一米八五。
20出头的年纪，面部如刀刻斧凿般，称不上俊美，却有一种别样的阳刚气。
“你们是武道初学者，应该都知道，练拳不练功，到老一场空……这功，就是日复一日的基本功。”
“桩功，能由外而内地按摩内脏、冲刷骨髓，能帮你们将各种筋骨气血药剂发挥出最大作用，尽快提升生命层次，继而觉醒‘虚空星相’。”

“好的桩功，是考上武道本科，乃至未来成为星空武者的基石……”方羽讲述道。
听到‘本科’‘星空武者’这些字眼，许多初学站桩不久，身体已很是煎熬的少年少女，都不由精神一振，咬牙坚持。
方羽见状也暗自感慨。
在这个科技高度发达，内卷又不断加剧的时代，若能考上武道本科，绝对属于改命，这也是那么多家长投入大量资源将孩子早早送到武道培训班的缘故。
而星空武者？
自新历以来人类登陆月星，人类诞生出第一位星空武者，谁还没有听说过星空武者的传说？
那是能以肉身横渡星空的绝世武者。
更是整个文明的擎天柱石！
这个时代，少年们崇拜的不是什么明星歌手，而是强大的武者。
“年轻，真是好啊……”
方羽看着自己教导的这些少年学员，仿佛见到几年前的自己，心中思绪也在发散：“可惜，高考只有一次机会，我当年高中没能觉醒虚空星相，被迫武道大专，再想上本科，只有专升本这一条路了。”
作为武道大专生。
哪怕方羽是非常优秀的大专生……专升本希望也很小。
“如果当年能觉醒虚空星相，哪怕只是中等星相，我现在应该都在冲击30级高级武者，未来巡天有望吧。”方羽心中暗叹。
星空武道之路。
觉醒虚空星相是第一步……若是没能觉醒，别说成为传说中的星空武者，这一生想达到30级高级武者都难。
……
半小时的桩功修炼后，伴随方羽的一声‘休息’，大半学员都瘫软在地。
方羽见状一笑。
content_en:
;;
The year 2046 in the old calendar is the 60th year in the new calendar.
July 12th.
Blue Star, Xia Kingdom, Huguang Province, Wuling City.
At two o'clock in the afternoon, the midsummer sun was like a big fireball, cloudless, and except for passing vehicles, there were not many pedestrians on most streets.
But at the entrance of a five-story building with a very large area and a high-tech exterior decoration facing the street, there are cars parked at the moment, and a large number of parents are pouring into it with their teenagers and girls wearing exercise uniforms facing the sun.
On the building plaque, there are four big characters written "Tieshan Martial Arts Society", and there is a line of small characters "Xinjiekou Branch" at the bottom.
There are more than a dozen brand new posters posted on the side of the door:
""The Great Summer Enrollment Discount of 60 Years in the New Calendar": For students in the prime age group, the tuition fee is 5,888,820 class hours, with patrolling warriors on site and elite warriors providing one-on-one guidance, which is the strongest support for the pursuit of undergraduate martial arts!!"
""Parent Certificate" Sprint Class": For adults in the silver age group before the age of 30, if they succeed in the sprint and are qualified to have children, they will be rewarded with one million yuan for one child!!"
""Counterattack from a low-ranking high school to the most powerful university": Special lecture by 'Jiang Chenyi', an elite student trained by our club, the top scorer in the city's college entrance examination in 1959, and an outstanding student of Crescent Martial Arts University..."
…
On the fourth floor, there is a martial arts room covering an area of over 500 square meters.
The ground is covered with a thick special mat, surrounded by sandbags, wooden dummies, weapon racks and other equipment. On the other side are boxing strength testers, body skills testers, life testers and other instruments.
More than forty junior high school students, who looked about thirteen or fourteen years old, were wearing uniforms and practicing kung fu.
"Stand your feet shoulder-width apart, with your toes slightly buckled in. Your knees should be slightly bent, no more than your toes. Keep your chest high and your back straight, with your head hanging..." Fang Yu, wearing a coaching uniform, patiently instructs each student.
He is about 1.85 meters tall.
He is in his early 20s, and his face is as chiseled as a knife. He cannot be called handsome, but he has a different kind of masculinity.
"You are beginners in martial arts, and you should all know that if you practice boxing without practicing kung fu, you will be in vain...this kung fu is the basic skill day after day."
"The Zhuang Gong can massage the internal organs from the outside in and wash away the bone marrow. It can help you maximize the effects of various muscles, bones, qi and blood medicines, improve your life level as soon as possible, and then awaken the 'Void Star Phase'."
"Good Zhuang Gong is the cornerstone for getting admitted to the Bachelor of Martial Arts, and even becoming a star warrior in the future..." Fang Yu said.
Hearing the words "undergraduate" and "star warrior", many young and girls who had just started to stand up and were already suffering a lot of physical pain could not help but cheer up and gritted their teeth to persevere.
Fang Yu also sighed secretly when he saw this.
In this era of highly advanced technology and ever-increasing involution, being admitted to a bachelor's degree in martial arts will definitely change your life. This is why so many parents invest a lot of resources in sending their children to martial arts training classes early.
And the starry sky warrior?
Since the New Calendar, humans have landed on the Moon and Star, and the first starry sky warrior has been born. Who hasn’t heard of the legend of the starry sky warrior?
That is a peerless warrior who can physically cross the starry sky.
It is the Optimus Prime Stone of the entire civilization!
In this era, what young people admire is not star singers, but powerful warriors.
"It's great to be young..."
Fang Yu looked at the young students he taught, as if he had seen himself a few years ago, and his thoughts were diverging: "Unfortunately, there is only one chance to take the college entrance examination. I failed to awaken the void star in high school, so I was forced to go to a junior college in martial arts. If I want to go to undergraduate, the only way is to upgrade from junior college to bachelor's degree."
As a martial arts college student.
Even if Fang Yu is an excellent junior college student... his chances of getting promoted to junior college are very small.
"If I could have awakened the void astrology back then, even if it was just a medium astrology, I should be fighting for a level 30 high-level warrior now. There is hope for sky surveys in the future." Fang Yu secretly sighed in his heart.
The road to starry sky martial arts.
Awakening to the void astrology is the first step...if you fail to awaken,Let alone becoming a legendary starry sky warrior, it would be difficult to reach level 30 advanced warrior in this life.
…
After half an hour of practicing Zhuang Kung Fu, most of the students collapsed on the ground as Fang Yu said "take a break".
Fang Yu smiled when he saw this.
